add.title: Press any key you want to add...

useTextColorAsOutline.name: Use Text Color as Outline Color

fancySpace.name: Fancy Space
fancySpace.description: Replaces the "SPACE" text with a space character

bigSpace.name: Big Space
bigSpace.description: Makes the space key bigger, giving it the width of three keys

sensitivity.name: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How far the dot moves when you turn. Higher values make small movements easier to see.

returnTime.name: Return Time (ms)
returnTime.description: How long the dot takes to get halfway back to the center once you stop moving.

padShape.name: Shape
padShape.description: Shape of the area the dot moves in.

size.name: Pad Size
size.description: Width and height of the area the dot moves in.

showCenterCross.name: Center Lines
showCenterCross.description: Draw a horizontal and a vertical line through the center.

showTrail.name: Trail
showTrail.description: Leave a fading trail behind the dot.

trailDuration.name: Trail Length (ms)
trailDuration.description: How far back in time the trail reaches.

showCps.name: Show CPS
showCps.description: Show your left and right clicks per second in two boxes below.

cpsGap.name: CPS Gap
cpsGap.description: Space between the pad and the click boxes.
